ops.text: (c) Limitation of Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, (i) neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages, and (ii) each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (A) the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and (B) USD 1,000,000. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. The Company's payment obligations under this Agreement are not "damages" for purposes of the foregoing limitations.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no liability provision, so we add one mutual cap at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, with a mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages and confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnity, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap. We have anchored the fee limb to the claim and confirmed the Company's payment obligations are not "damages", per our liability position; a straight 12 months' fees cap is our fallback if the USD 1,000,000 limb is an issue.
proposal.summary: Insert a mutual liability cap (greater of 12 months' fees preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000), mutual indirect/consequential damages exclusion, uncapped Excluded Claims, and confirmation that payment obligations are not damages.

mappings.element: Cap equal to the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
Uncapped breach of data protection obligations.
Uncapped infringement of the other party's IP.
Customer's payment obligations are not damages for cap purposes.
